_comment: Deep Time (8I). The ONE copy of every date in the lesson, in millions of years ago (Mya). The deck, the worksheet answers and the checkers read this file; the game carries a copy that build/check-deep-time-game.py compares with it. Sources (checked 2026-10-07): ICS International Chronostratigraphic Chart (Cambrian base 538.8, Permian-Triassic 251.9, Cretaceous-Paleogene 66.0); Dresser Formation stromatolites (life, 3,500); Middle Ordovician spores (land plants, 470); earliest dinosaurs, Late Triassic (230); Brasilodon (mammals, 225); Archaeopteryx (birds, 150); Montsechia (flowering plants, 130); Tiktaalik (375); Haikouichthys (fish, 530); Ediacaran animals (about 575); Great Oxidation Event (2,400); Jebel Irhoud Homo sapiens (0.3); Isthmus of Panama (about 3); Darwin's finches' ancestor (about 2, Lamichhaney and others 2015); the Big Five extinctions and their losses (Our World in Data). The Precambrian is strictly a supereon, taught here as the first era, as the brief asks.

life: First life (single cells in the sea)
oxygen: Oxygen builds up in the air
tetrapods: Fish with leg-like fins crawl onto land
asteroid: The asteroid hits and the last dinosaurs die out
finches: The finches' ancestor reaches the Galápagos
